claim: git internals macOS duplicates: .git/index 2/3 and .git/refs/heads/* 2 corrupt git state (repack fatals, wrong ref targets). Fix: rm numbered refs; git remote prune origin clears remote-tracking dupes. Check: find .git -name '* 2' -o -name '* 3'. .git should never be in iCloud-synced folder.
